title: tenant-onboard-policy-generator-and-graceful-upgrade-guardrails
author: Maya Patel
body: Motivation: Private installs require tenant onboarding to be safe and repeatable across upgrades. Current RBAC seeding is brittle during Helm upgrades and terraform-driven infra changes; operators frequently need to hand-run fixes. This PR introduces a tenant-onboard policy generator that emits parameterized tenant-scoped Role/RoleBinding and ServiceAccount templates, plus Helm pre-upgrade guardrails that detect destructive RBAC drift and block upgrades unless an explicit operator-approved drift token is provided. Design summary: - Add a small generator CLI (installer/policygen) that produces idempotent YAML (Roles, RoleBindings, Namespaces, Saa templates) from tenant metadata and operator config. Templates are parameterized (labels, tenant-id, isolation-mode) so the same generator is used for initial bootstrap and for later reconciliation. - Introduce a Helm pre-upgrade hook (charts/preflight/policy-check) which runs a dry-run policy lint and a simulated apply against a sandbox namespace using the generated templates. If the lint or simulation would remove required bootstrap permissions, the hook exits non-zero and the upgrade is blocked. - Add a terraform module output mapping so infra automation can consume the generated SA names/ARNs/IDs without parsing YAML. - Provide a safe-rollback playbook: when upgrades are blocked, operators can run "installer policygen --snapshot" to create a snapshot of current bindings, submit to the ops ticket, and the rollout can be retried with a deliberate --allow-policy-drift flag after manual review. Checklist: - [x] policy generator binary + unit tests - [x] Helm pre-upgrade hook + simulated apply runner - [x] terraform outputs + examples in examples/terraform-rbac - [x] idempotency tests for repeated generator runs - [x] integration e2e harness for preflight (flaky fixed) - [x] docs update in docs/private/onboarding.md Migration notes: On deploy, operators should run `installer policygen --tenant <id> --isolation-mode strict` and commit generated YAML to the tenant manifests repo or feed into terraform via the new outputs. Rollback: if an upgrade is blocked, follow the playbook at docs/private/upgrade-playbook.md which includes snapshot-and-restore steps. Security considerations: templates avoid embedding plaintext credentials; ServiceAccounts are referenced by name only and KMS/HSM integration is documented for any secrets. Links: Linear ENG-1972 for generator work; SRE-264 for upgrade guard requirements; internal doc: docs/private/upgrade-playbook.md
commits: 4a7e9ab: add role/rolebinding and serviceaccount templates + parameter interpolation
9f2b11e: charts: add preflight policy-check hook and simulator container image reference
a28c5d0: terraform: expose rbac outputs for tenancy module
b7e3f22: e2e: add integration test for preflight hook; fix flakiness by adding wait-retry
d0ff11c: docs: onboarding and upgrade-playbook updates
review_thread: Diego Alvarez (reviewer): The generator looks good overall. Two asks before merge: (1) ensure generated RoleBindings include an annotation with a stable generator fingerprint so we can detect external mutation, (2) add a CI step that runs the generator with --tenant dummy and diffs against a golden file to catch regressions.

Maya Patel (author): Addressed both: added metadata.annotations.generatorFingerprint and a generator-golden test under ci/generator-golden. Also added a short note in onboarding.md describing who owns the golden files.

Rina Sato (reviewer): We need to be explicit about the Helm hook failing open vs failing closed. Right now the chart blocks upgrades which is correct for strict isolation, but we should have a per-release override. Suggest adding values.preflight.failIfPolicyDrift = true and documented operator override.

Maya Patel (author): Added values.preflight.failIfPolicyDrift with default true and documented the override in charts/README.md. Also added a clear warning to the upgrade-playbook about the --allow-policy-drift operator flag and required approval process.

Evan Brooks (security reviewer): Confirm SA names do not contain tenant secrets and that KMS integrations are only referenced in docs. Also please add a short note in installer/README about secret handling and recommend KMS + short-lived tokens for bootstrap flows.

Maya Patel (author): Confirmed; removed any secret embedding from templates and added the KMS recommendation section. E2E tests assert that no file contains the string 'PRIVATE_KEY' or similar patterns.
Diego Alvarez (reviewer): CI flaky e2e failure observed on first run (policy simulator sometimes exceeds pod startup timeout). Re-run CI to verify fixes.
CI bot: e2e/preflight failed on first run due to container image pull backoff (transient); tests re-run and passed.
Rina Sato (approver): Approved after verifying golden test and added helm value. Approving to merge.
Merge-bot: Squash and merge completed by Maya Patel.
merge_summary: Squashed commits into a single logical change. Added tenant onboarding policy generator, helm preflight guard hook, terraform outputs, e2e tests, and documentation. Includes golden tests to prevent regressions and per-release guard overrides.
release_notes: Add installer policy generator for tenant RBAC, Helm pre-upgrade policy checks that block destructive RBAC drift, and terraform outputs for tenancy RBAC. Operators should run the new policygen during onboarding and follow the documented upgrade-playbook when upgrades are blocked.
notes_for_release_team: This changes the default behavior of private Helm upgrades for tenants with isolation-mode strict. Release engineering: announce to private-ops Slack channel and include in next private-upgrade runbook. Operators must be taught how to use --allow-policy-drift flag and the snapshot workflow.
